notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Major update for the test version of the game (pre-alpha).
What's included in this update:
[list]
[*] Map constructor.
You can create any maps from the blocks.
[*] New game mechanics.
Playing for the ball, you need to score the ball into the opponent's goal.
[*] Weapon.
Any weapon can be used in matches depending on the mode.
[/list]
